Social media influencer announces free iPhone 17 giveaway in Chandigarh

Social media influencer Raja D King announced a free iPhone 17 giveaway in Chandigarh, calling it an "iPhone Langar". The scheme requires participants to write the phrase “Jai Mata Di” each day to become eligible. The promotion follows his earlier “petrol langar” campaign that distributed fuel vouchers. No government agency is reported to be involved in the giveaway. Coverage notes the event is being promoted through social‑media platforms.
